verdict.rationale: Relay's support docs say most applications are reviewed within 1–2 business days with status tracking and email notification, and accounts can be configured in-app with accounting sync to QuickBooks/Xero and Plaid connections, which supports a fast start. There is no evidence of a guided switching or migration process that gets a founder fully operational in about a week. The 5–7 day card timeline cited refers to replacements, not new-account delivery. Missing for 10: documented end-to-end onboarding/migration timeline, switching tools (e.g., moving payees or direct deposits), new card delivery times, independent or hands-on corroboration of onboarding speed.
